title: Writer occupancy at a fixed arrival rate
method: Synthetic arrival rate is 100 write transactions/second. Occupancy = arrival rate × average writer hold time ×100, giving 20%, 50% and 90% for 2, 5 and 9 ms. This excludes bursts, variance and checkpoint effects and does not forecast latency.
alt: Writer occupancy at a fixed arrival rate. 2 ms transactions: 20 percent; 5 ms transactions: 50 percent; 9 ms transactions: 90 percent. Illustrative values.
